images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an art-direction reference for Ambient Brief 2.0 Living World, a premium indie-game stylized 3D temperate Atlantic island. Landscape 16:9. No text or UI; this is concept art, not a screenshot. Composed stable three-quarter aerial from south looking north, restrained perspective, horizon in upper fifth. Asymmetric crescent island with layered pale limestone cliffs, grass, wind-shaped maritime pines, weathered cedar, dark bronze and blue-green ocean. Four unmistakably different connected landmarks: central elevated contemporary oval glass observatory with thin bronze roof and stone terrace; slender pale eastern cliff lighthouse at right with bronze lantern cap, tallest silhouette; western low cedar signal station at left with small elegant mast; southern foreground harbor market pavilion with broad shallow cedar roof and stone quay. Visible narrow footpaths connect all four; beach in southwest, rocky eastern promontory, no floating island cutaway. Sophisticated rough materials, bevels, subdued reflections, soft ambient occlusion, warm morning side light, cool atmospheric depth. Clear negative ocean/sky space at left 27 percent for a later HTML clock/news rail; island occupies right 65 percent with every building silhouette separated. Preserve 12 percent quiet bottom space for later HTML context. Peaceful, inhabited through crafted architecture, no people needed, no fantasy towers, no neon, Minecraft blocks, default primitives, photographic asset-kit mismatch, text, logos, charts or interface cards. Art quality target: authored environmental game art with legible large shapes and tactile medium detail.
images.review: Four landmarks and coastal palette established; too much photoreal microdetail; full-frame art does not validate HTML safe areas.
